title: The Day the Rain Came
skill: Vowel Teams (ai, ay, ea, ee, oa)
skill_description: Words with vowel teams: ai (rain, wait), ay (day, play), ea (leaf, dream), ee (green, see), oa (toad, road, coat)
author: FunBookies
summary: Kay plants seeds and waits for rain. Day after day, the sky stays gray. She dreams of green leaves and keeps hope alive. When rain finally comes, Kay learns that good things take time.
character_description: Kay, a young girl around 6 years old with curious eyes and a hopeful smile, wearing simple clothes and often a coat

kay.distinguishing_feature: hopeful expression, often looking up at sky

art_direction.style: Soft watercolor illustration, warm and cozy, child's-eye perspective
art_direction.palette: Muted grays and browns transitioning to bright greens

story_bible.premise: Kay plants seeds and waits for rain. As days stay dry and gray, she learns that good things need time—and that waiting can be its own kind of hope.

character_arcs.Kay: Wants her seeds to grow, faces the obstacle of no rain, learns to keep caring, and is rewarded when rain finally comes

story_bible.setting: A small cottage with a backyard garden. Rural feel with wooden fence, clay pots, winding trail to the road.
story_bible.visual_style: Soft watercolor, muted grays becoming vibrant greens. Garden as central visual anchor.

emotional_beats.beat: Kay plants seeds in clay soil
She waits. Gray day. No rain.
Nature is alive: snail, toad. But no rain.
Kay asks if rain will come.
Kay dreams of green leaves and bees.
She wakes. Still gray. Feels sad.
Kay gets her pail to help the seeds.
A green leaf appears. Dream came true.
